DOE v. HARBOR LABS, INC.
Conversion-Notice, 2012-10-26
Page 1 of 2
Notice converting the bridge note into preferred stock at the discount.
Bridge note converts at a discount.
Bridge note converted at a discount, lifting Alder Peak past 30 percent.
Note converts and Alder Peak rises past 30 percent.
Preferred shares issued on conversion.
The parties to this matter are fictional, and so is every fact on this page.
Section 1. Definitions. Capitalized terms have the meanings given in the agreement.
Section 2. Records. The corporate secretary keeps the board records at the company
office.
Section 3. Meetings. Directors meet on the days the notice sets.
Section 4. Notices. Notices are given in writing to the addresses on file.
